notes: the first branch «حدثنا محمد بن جعفر بن زياد، وقال، أخبرنا ح» names no teacher after «أخبرنا»: the group stops at Muhammad b. Ja'far, and nothing is filled in
«قالا حدثنا إبراهيم بن سعد» joins both branches, so Ibrahim, his father (bare, a relation), Humayd and Abdullah b. Amr form the shared tail
«وقال» is the verb of the compiler's line, not a name
